entries.response: An ISP performance tracker (CLI + dashboard). There's no app.py — main.py is the entrypoint. Subcommands: "start netpulse" (dashboard on :5000), "run once" (single measurement), "watch network" (loop at an interval — I'll ask how often), "export data" (CSV), "demo mode" (seed fake data).
